newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate panel delays vote on Banerj loan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate panel delays vote on Banerj loan.

text.p: A Brazilian Senate committee has delayed until next week a vote crucial to the privatization of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, a congressional official said.
"The president of the commission conceded to requests for more time," said an official at the Senate's Economic Affairs Committee.
The privatization of Banerj hinges on approval by the Senate of a 3.09 billion real ($2.89 billion) loan to Rio de Janeiro state by federally owned mortgage bank Caixa Economica Federal.
The loan would be used to clear up Banerj's pension and payroll-related debts and make the bank attractive to private investors.
Four private banks -- Bradesco, Banco Itau, BCN and Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana -- have qualifed for the privatization auction.
The loan must be approved by the committee, which is scheduled to meet again next Tuesday, and then by the floor of the Senate.
